name: Catfish UK The TV Show
summary:
Julie Adenuga and Oobah Butler have been announced as the co-hosts of Catfish: The TV Show for MTV UK.

Catfish UK is the first international iteration of the hit TV show, which follows the real-life stories of individuals in online relationships with partners they've never met in person.

The series will launch with four one-hour episodes on MTV UK and around the world beginning in spring 2021, with six more episodes following later in the year

name: O'Hanlon's Helden
summary: Bestseller author and born storyteller Redmond O'Hanlon (who has been born in the wrong century) travels along the same path as his heroes: the explorers of the 19th century. How little did they know about the world around them? How many -still unknown- places waiting to be discovered?

name: The World's Most Dangerous Borders
summary: Explorer and filmmaker Reza Pakravan has set off on an epic journey along Africa's most volatile and dangerous borders to discover the lives of those who live there.

name: Ancient Engineering
summary: Using the latest technological insights, this series sheds new light on how incredible feats of ancient engineering were achieved and how they continue to influence modern-day engineers and shape our world.

previousepisode.name: The Taj Mahal and The Golden Age of Islam

name: Kronprinsesse Mette-Marit
summary: NRK has followed the Crown Princess for a year and a half, the result is a TV portrait in two parts.

name: My Lascivious Boss
summary: My Lascivious Boss is about Minh Hoang - the agile and smart boy, but he has to face up with many difficulties in his life. To pay for a living as well as take care of his mother, he's been in 2 different jobs simultaneously. Thanks to the assistance of Quang Lam and Quoc Bao, Minh Hoang's working at the coffee shop. Besides this part-time job, Minh Hoang and his friend - Gia Vy work as a streamer. Back at the coffee shop, Thien Long, a sexy guy, who's always willing to have one night stand with girls to forget My Hanh - Thien Khoi's wife, who also owns this coffee shop. Minh Hoang unfortunately has some trouble with Thien Long.

name: Sunday Night Fever
summary: In Sunday Night Fever on RTL 4, Chantal Janzen goes in search of the best protagonist for the musical Saturday Night Fever. In five live shows it must become clear which of the twelve candidates wins.

name: Son of the Dragon
summary: When the Royal Family decides to accept suitors for the hand of Princess Li Wei, a young thief who calls himself 'Devil Boy' decides to pose as a prince in order to swipe the crown jewels. To his surprise, he ends up genuinely falling in love with the young woman, placing himself and his faithful servant in the crosshairs of the dangerous Prince of the North.

name: Yu Chen Tong Guang
summary: After Li Chu Yao loses her younger brother Chu Chen to an accident, Li Luo Shu, the orphan who lives across the street, takes Chu Chen's place in the Li household to appease his mentally unstable mother. Years pass, and Luo Shu develops romantic feelings for his ‘older sister', though decides to keep them hidden after Chu Yao falls in love with and gets engaged to Han Zi Mo. Unfortunately, Han Zi Mo goes on the run after loan sharks come knocking at his door, and Chu Yao is left with a mountain of debt. Luo Shu is gravely injured while trying to protect her, and Chu Yao eventually realizes who she truly loves. They promise to spend the rest of their lives together, yet are soon forced apart by reality.

name: Wang Ji Ni Ji De Ai Qing
summary: Shan Junhao, the CEO of a large hotel chain, meets Ye Tianyu, a schemer, and gold-digger.

name: Virus Wai Love: Nakrob Chut Kao
summary: The story is about the romance between a female doctor and a playboy engineering student during the COVID-19 pandemic.

name: Jonahs dyreverden
summary: Jonah loves animals and he takes us on a journey between the continents where we meet small and large animals from all corners of the world.

name: Doktor Ballouz
summary: In a small clinic in the Uckermark, the gifted and unusual doctor Amin Ballouz fights for the well-being of his patients and at the same time against his own past. As a young man, he fled his homeland and found a new home in the Uckermark. He has a big heart, always wears a trench coat and drives a Trabi. As a doctor, he practices passionately and does not shy away from unconventional measures. His patients are his family - the hospital is his life. But suddenly he is confronted with the unexpected death of his wife. A short time after the loss, he returned to the clinic. But is he ready for it yet? Those around him try to help him find his way back to life.

name: Agatha Christie's Hjerson
summary:
Former investigator Sven Hjerson has solved some of the toughest cases in Swedish crime history. Now retired from the limelight, living on the fringes of society, his life mainly consists of daily routines, a vegan diet, vinyl record collecting and an unhealthy appetite for gossip.

Klara Sandberg is a reality TV producer living with her partner Niklas and their daughter Olivia. Her career has stagnated and she is looking for something new – is this really all that life has to offer? When she manages to successfully pitch the idea for a new TV show starring Hjerson, it could just be the solution to all of her problems. There's just one snag – she's never actually met Sven Hjerson...

name: Pete & Sam's Reality News
summary: TOWIE's Pete Wicks and Made in Chelsea's Sam Thompson anchor a reality news series, delivering the latest juicy gossip and breaking stories making the headlines in the reality world.

name: Don't Disturb My Study
summary: Xiang Wan wakes up reliving her second year of high school. However, she is no longer the best in class but a loser at the bottom of the barrel. In her desperate sprint back to the top, she gradually reverses her prejudices about others.

name: След саламандры
summary: A series about love and cruelty, treachery and all-winning maternal instinct.

name: The Yorkshire Auction House
summary: Auctioneer Angus Ashworth has been running his auction house for more than a decade. With the help of his team and family, he clears out cluttered homes, uncovering hidden gems that he can sell at auction.

nextepisode.name: A House Full of Secrets & Silver

name: Serpiente
summary: Don't be deceived by its looks, or you might fall on a trap. This is the untold story of Serpiente.

name: Paul de Leeuw Top 12
summary: During the Marathon episode of Mooi! weer De Leeuw a Top 12 of Paul's most memorable scenes was made.

name: Marta a Věra
summary:
Marta and Věra are employees of the discount portal leeevne.cz but their approach to life is completely different. Marta believes in its work which helps people and loves when everything is in order but is full of illusions. Věra has a strong experience with no illusions and she enjoys to improvise in order to cope with every situation.

Brouček (their boss) is a kind of a manager who must manage and spy on everything and everyone like a dictator, so his two employees have a hard time.

The characters of the show are thrown into situations where every discount they sell has a catch. For example a ride in a horse chaise without a horse, or a work shift in a mine without a return.

name: Andre Rieu op het Vrijthof
summary: A 2-part concert. This summer André Rieu and his johann Strauss orchestra gave an open air concert at one of the most beautiful and most romantic squares of The Netherlands, the Vrijthof in Maastricht.

name: En fråga om liv och död
summary: Doctor David Bendricks witnesses a brutal mafia murder during a jogging trip and decides to testify against the killers. A fateful decision, it turns out, when the police are unable to protect his family. Now it remains only for David to take the law into his own hands.

name: Stockholm - Båstad
summary: The retired tennis player Pavel Edvardsson has managed to get a wild card for the Swedish Open. When best friend Danne suggests that they take the boat from Stockholm to Båstad the week before the tournament, Pavel can not say no. But parties and other antics make up for Pavel's recharging plans.

name: Kronjuvelerna
summary: Fragancia is arrested for the attempted murder of Richard Persson, the son of a powerful factory owner. During the interrogation her amazing and remarkable life story is revealed. We follow her through her impoverished childhood, her adolescence where she meets the great love of her life, ice hockey star Petterson-Jonsson and the lead up to the fatal night where the story begins.

name: Leende guldbruna ögon
summary: 23-year-old Lennart Johansson from Fellingsbro is dark-skinned and wants to become a dance band star, and has Christer Sjögren as his idol. He wants to sing with the dance band Sven Bodins, but does not get in because of his skin color. Sven Bodins claims that there are too many racial prejudices in the dance band genre, but claims that he does not mind dark-skinned dance band singers. Lennart Johansson then decides to start his own dance band.

name: Het sterke geslacht
summary: Who is the stronger sex? Man or woman? Bruno Wyndaele thinks it is time to make a decision and therefore makes an appointment for "The Strong Sex". In this program, 2 teams of famous compatriots will compete. Filip Peeters leads the men and Goedele Liekens the women. In each episode, Filip and Goedele choose a theme - for example, adaptability, orientation, intelligence, motor skills, team spirit - and 2 team members to compete. Their game arena is Lesbos, one of the largest Greek islands but unspoiled by mass tourism. The nature is vast, the villages small and life is traditional. The teams choose 3 matches in each episode to illustrate the theme. Are the clichés confirmed? Or can men also multi-task, can women park, do men have a sense of fashion and are women able to find their way? In short, are the men "The Strong Sex"? Or the women?

name: De schat van de Oranje
summary: Twelve well-known Dutch people are looking for a valuable VOC treasure. The participants have to puzzle and search a lot to collect information about the location of the treasure, but also play tactically. Who do you share your information with and with whom do you not? What is your knowledge worth and who can you trust? Every week someone has to go home after the elimination round. Three people eventually play the final, in which the smartest treasure hunter wins 35,000 euros.

name: Den Uyl en de affaire Lockheed
summary: In February 1976 it is announced that a senior Dutch government official has taken a bribe from aircraft manufacturer Lockheed. It soon becomes clear that this means Prince Bernhard. The country is in turmoil when it appears that Prince Bernhard has actually accepted a bribe. Juliana threatens to resign. The monarchy is faltering. When senior soldiers start to interfere in solidarity with the Prince and also ask the people for openness, Den Uyl can no longer postpone his decision. Does he choose to preserve the monarchy or not? A political thriller and a royal drama.

name: My America
summary:
In the four-part documentary series My America, America correspondent Michiel Vos shows what it means to be an American. Like most of his interviewees, Vos is an immigrant. After a ceremony on Ellis Island in 2010 in which he pledged allegiance to the American flag, he was naturalized.

In addition to interviews with well-known immigrants (and their children) such as Barack Obama, Henry Kissinger, Arnold Schwarzenegger and fashion queen Diane von Furstenberg, the viewer is introduced to "his" America. Vos' emigrant life seems like a modern American fairytale. One of the reasons he can meet prominent guests is his mother-in-law, Nancy Pelosi, the first female Speaker of the United States House of Representatives and one of America's most influential women. Fox's wife, filmmaker Alexandra Pelosi, provides access to the world of cinema. For example, barbecues in the backyard of the White House and backstage meetings with famous media figures are part of his existence as an immigrant.

Yet "The American Dream" is not merely positive. For example, Vos takes a critical look at the American love for weapons and the Iraq war. America as an example, but also as a warning.

name: Casino
summary: The casino is a meeting place of dreams, loves and luck, where anyone can turn: a widowed casino owner who has returned from America and wants to get rid of her husband's legacy at all costs, a step-son who is ready to help with the sale, he knows some underworld figures, a balanced boss who falls in love with the best stuntman in the country, a number mage countess whose nothing escapes his attention, and even a security guard, a taxi driver, a brother and sister, a journalist, a reporter, a lawyer, waitresses, employees, regulars; in a word, many determined players. Here everyone bets and the wheel never stops.

name: God of Ten Thousand Realms
summary: At the end of the calendar 2020, the continent of Stern, which has reached the end of civilization due to the exhaustion of magic elements, ushered in the destruction of the continent under the void storm. Ye Xuan, the last god of law in the mainland, unexpectedly awakened in the era of the prosperous magic civilization three thousand years ago and became an ordinary student at the Sith Magic Academy on the border of the Kingdom of Orlando in the northwest of the mainland. In order to save the mainland and prevent the end from coming, Ye Xuan began to explore the mystery of the dark turmoil that led to the depletion of magical elements in the mainland three thousand years ago, to prevent the mainland crisis.

name: Спасти босса
summary: Zhenya really wants to find her female happiness and a good job. She decided to start with the latter. The girl gets the desired job, but there is one risk - falling in love. She is taken to the position of secretary to the son of the head of the company, where her new boss Alexander turns out to be a terrible lazy person.

name: Acans
summary: Copywriter of the years Tuncay, a customer representative eager to become a happy writer, antidepressant addicted agency president Ece and the enthusiastic young employees Burcu and Can together with surprise guests who will take place in each section, we witness the daily crises of an extraordinary agency, its absurd agendas, and its struggles with troubled brands and customers for advertising campaigns.

name: В активном поиске
summary: The successful life of the co-founder of a large advertising agency, Andrey, has everything: an apartment in the city center, and fashionable friends, and a great future in the advertising field. But one day, a nine-year-old child appears on the threshold of his house, claiming that he is his son. Now Andrey has a difficult path ahead: to become a father without giving up his career, and, most importantly, to find the mother of a child from dozens of his former lovers.

name: Deeds
summary: Deeds is about a desperate realtor who embarks on an increasingly dark path when she's forced to team up with a drug-addicted, sociopathic, young couple who soon discover that in the world of high-end, LA real estate, when it comes to immorality and cutthroat behavior, they're outmatched.

name: Shakespeares skjulte koder
summary:
Petter Amundsen claims to have found hitherto unknown codes in William Shakespeare's play. The codes say that Shakespeare is not the actual author, but rather a paid front figure in a Masonic project.

This Norwegian-produced documentary series in four parts shows how the organist Petter Amundsen from Oslo reveals a treasure map of codes in Shakespeare's literature. The findings lead into a story that includes the Knights Templar and the missing Knights Templar treasure. Dan Brown touches on this in the Da Vinci Code, but Amundsen's story surpasses fiction. It is based on facts that can all be verified.

If Petter Amundsen achieves recognition for his theories, the history of literature will have to be rewritten. He will forever stand as the man who solved Shakespeare's great riddle. Should he fail, he will be left as a fanatic in the ranks of naive conspiracy theorists.

name: De Zaterdagavondshow met Marc-Marie & Beau
summary: The Saturday evening show with Marc-Marie and Beau at SBS 6 makes dreams come true again in a special, funny and emotional way. In the studio show, Marc-Marie Huijbregts and Beau van Erven Dorens will make different dreams of people in the audience come true. No dream is too crazy for Beau and Marc-Marie and of course they do everything in their power to realize the requests in a playful way in the studio.

name: Fyra små filmer
summary: Four small films is a series of TV films in four parts produced by Killinggänget which was shown in the spring of 1999. The black humor they express in these films can be seen as a transition from the light-hearted tone in NileCity 105.6 and Percy Tears to the gravely serious in Four Shades of Brown.

previousepisode.name: Torsk på Tallinn – en liten film om ensamhet

name: I Jan Baalsruds fotspor
summary: Special soldiers Ronny Bratli and Rune Gjeldnes relive the incredible escape story of Jan Baalsrud through North Troms. After the war, the Linge soldier became world famous through the book and film Ni Liv. The escape starts in Toftefjord when a German warship attacks the fishing boat with the sabotage group. Rune and Ronny have to go through the same icy ordeals that Baalsrud barely survived.

previousepisode.name: Soldat med flere enn ni liv

name: Taxi
summary: A young lawyer Javar receives information about taxi fraud in Oslo. Documentation is found on a memory stick he receives from his brother-in-law Ahmad. Javar tips journalist girlfriend Anne, who is also starting to dig into the matter. There are powerful forces they challenge ...

name: In the Box
summary:
In his ProSieben show "Schulz in the Box", Olli Schulz asks himself what would have been if he had given his life a different direction.

Curious about everything unknown, he lets himself be "kidnapped" from his familiar surroundings: crammed into a wooden box, Olli is shipped to a wide variety of places with very special people and special tasks.

The entertainer has to find his way around his new situation without preparation: locked behind bars, immersed in the bizarre hit world, exposed in Tokyo or under the wing of a Russian oligarch - Olli Schulz has to endure a completely foreign life for 24 hours...

At the end of the first season, Olli Schulz quit the show and for the second season, various celebrities were instead placed in the box.

name: New Chicks: Brabantse nachten op Curaçao
summary:
The five single girls in this new program have a number of things in common: they are Brabantian, beautiful, young and they are looking for love. The female singles stay in a luxury villa in sun-drenched Curacao to meet the love of their life.

Every episode boys from all over the Netherlands come to stay in the villa. These unbound boys have indicated in advance that they are interested in (one of the) Brabant beauties. The new chicks do not know the boys, but their wishes have been taken into account. What will happen after the chicks get to know their hunks, is this the man of their life or are they going for someone else?

The well-spoken babes are in charge throughout the series. They decide which guy they want to share their own double room with. At the end of each episode, the girls are faced with a choice: will they go for love or will they stay on Curacao? The villa must be left immediately if love is chosen. On the mat, another new chick from Brabant is ready to enter the villa.

name: Die unwahrscheinlichen Ereignisse im Leben von...
summary: As with the great "Saturday Night Live" model, a different prominent guest should greet the audience every week. Afterwards there will be films, skits and live performances by the ensemble, in which topics and events related to the celebrity guest are told over and over again.

name: Alliert og alene
summary: Two weeks after Norway was attacked in April 1940, the Norwegians fought a desperate battle against the world's largest military force in anticipation of Allied aid.

previousepisode.name: Da det var stas med tog

name: Amalies jul
summary: Amalies jul is a Norwegian Advent calendar for children. Can the Santa cub manage enough pixie tricks and pixie joys before the big test at Månetoppen? And will there be human beings in the big house?

name: Latela
summary: Latela follows everyday life of a group of car enthusiasts.

name: The Rules of Love
summary: Merperson Yang Luo Tian has always gone as a boy for most of his life. That is until he saved Lie Heng Yu from drowning. When a merperson first falls in love, the equivalent of puberty hits and their body begins to take on one gender. Yang Luo Tian finds his body and mind slowly turning female. To avoid scrutiny over her sudden changes, she switches colleges, only to still pose as a man after being recognized by her childhood friend. She soon ends up roommates with Lie Heng Yu. As if it's not hard enough hiding her gender from him, she also has to hide the fact that she cries pearls and her scales flare up when her skin touches the water.

name: Tamra, the Island
summary:
The drama is based on a manhwa with the same title. Tamna the Island is set in 17th-century Joseon times as a young English castaway, William, comes to the island and meets Jang Beo Jin, Park Kyu, and Yan. The name "Tamna" refers to what is now called Jeju.

The show started with low viewership, so the network wanted to cut it short to move on to other dramas. They trimmed and compressed arcs, which hurt the flow. Later, because the show gained a cult following (especially overseas), the full 21-episode version was released on DVD and internationally which contains full intended story with a different ending.

name: The Birth of a Family
summary: A drama about an adopted woman who struggles to make a family.

name: Street Outlaws: America's List
summary: Racers have proven they're willing to do whatever it takes to become the drivers who can go down any road, anywhere, anytime. And for the first time ever, racers from OKC, Memphis, Texas, NOLA, Detroit, Cali and everywhere in between will be ranked on a single list compiled of the best, baddest and fastest racers in the nation.

name: 60 Minutes Plus
summary: 60 Minutes+ is an exclusive new program on Paramount+ from '60 MINUTES', the most successful television news broadcast in history. The show is tailored for a growing younger audience, and offers hard-hitting investigative reports, feature segments, and profiles of people in the news in short documentary-style segments. Correspondents include Enrique Acevedo, Wesley Lowery, Laurie Segall, and Seth Doane.

name: Mon gâteau est le meilleur de France
Hoe word ik mama in Amsterdam-Zuid?
summary: In this show, Bridget Maasland experiences what it takes to become a mom. In her own way she literally experiences what it is like to become a mother. You can see how she plunges into the wonderful world of pickles, pregnancy courses, ultrasounds, maternity clothes, chic baby showers and all the baby must-haves that a mom-to-be can buy.

name: Käftsmäll med Random Making Movies
summary: No one is sure when the prank masters from Youtube, Random Making Movies, take the step over to Kanal 5 with their very own comedy program that mixes pranks, sketches and interviews in true RMM spirit.

name: De 10 over half vijf Paul de Leeuw show
summary: In each episode Paul De Leeuw receives a second class from a secondary school. He determines the theme of the broadcast and discusses this theme. The students also show a home-made photo report and there are live performances by artists. In short film sketches, De Leeuw can lose his comical egg. Every now and then you even catch a glimpse of future characters and his, sometimes cruel, sense of humor.

name: Rai Sanaeha
summary: Nongrarm is a stressed, jealous and bored middle-aged woman who falls in love with her niece's lover, but that love turns into obsession.

name: Crowns of Grass
summary: This is a story about people fighting for better lives and looking for opportunities in a big city. Praew and Pangkwan suddenly lost their sister because she was the victim of a hit and run by Purich. Payu got involved in this situation as he's trying to settle everything out for his brother and the victim's family. Pangkwan needs to start working in a Northeastern Food Restaurant because of her sister's death and the restaurant owner happened to be her ex-boyfriend, Dandin. However, the troublesome situation is not over yet, as Purich wants to take the restaurant away from these people. Payu does not like the idea and teams up with Praew to stop Purich and destroy his plan in every way. Will they be able to win the battle with an evil capitalist like Purich or not?

name: Lhong Fai
summary: Karnkaew, a girl studying in the province Bangkok. She can upgrade herself to a higher class when she gets an income as a courtesan. Her best friend is Chala, an unambitious girl who works as waitress to paid her credit fee. Karnkaew goes out with Gunchorn, a teacher who teaches at that school. Meanwhile she flirts with Arwut, her boss at the company, but she decides to break off with both of them, because she's wants to live a luxurious life and both Gunchorn and Arwut can't afford these things for her. So she needs to find new man who can give her a luxurious life.

name: The Wedding Coach
summary: Former bride and forever comedian Jamie Lee shares her irreverent yet practical tips and tricks for wedding planning with struggling lovebirds.

name: Battle Athletess Daiundokai ReSTART!
summary: Having defeated the space invaders, the Neriri aliens, humanity has expanded its residential area to the entire solar system and is enjoying its prosperity. One hundred years later... The humanity is now enthusiastic over Shin-Daiundokai! Girls from all over the solar system gather at a space colony called the University Satellite. They engage in fierce battles in a variety of sports for the title of the best in the universe. The final winner is called Cosmic Beauty, and is crowned Queen of the Solar System. Kanata Akehoshi, a girl from Earth, aims to become Cosmic Beauty in order to fulfill a promise she made when she was a child. After successfully winning the qualifying round at the Antarctic Training School, She arrives at the University Satellite. Then, she is reunited with the girl she once promised to meet. The girls' passionate sports battle for courage, hope, and pride is about to begin!

name: My Skirt, Where Did It Go?
summary: One day, Nobuo Harada starts work as a Japanese language teacher at a high school. He is gay and dresses like a woman. He sympathizes with the lives and worries of his students.

name: The Diary of the 38-year-old Divorcee who has tried a Dating App
summary: 38-year-old Matsumoto Chiaki is divorced and single. Because she married early at the age of 24, she has not had much experience with men. When she starts thinking of regaining the youth that she had lost, she is recommended a matching making app by her good friend Rika. Chiaki checks the app out of curiosity and discovers it is full of handsome younger men who do not care for age difference. She keeps going on wholesome dates with these young men. But one morning when Chiaki wakes up, she finds her clothes strewn around and a university student lying next to her

name: Alive: Dr. Kokoro, The Medical Oncologist
summary: Onda Kokoro is an oncologist called Dr Onkoro for short by the people around her and teased that she was born for this path. She got married to Takumi, whom she had known since she was a student, and they had a son. Life was going smoothly for her. But three months ago, her husband fell in an accident and remained unconsciousness even though he underwent emergency surgery. Although Kokoro puts on a brave face at work, she still has not been able to accept reality. One day, she meets Kajiyama Kaoru, a competent gastroenterologist who has transferred to work at the hospital. Kaoru understands the need for oncology as a surgeon and gives emotional support with her sunny personality as a colleague. She becomes a dear friend whom Kokoro feels is sudden a ray of light in her personal and professional life…

name: Олег
summary: Oleg, who lives at high speeds, is used to the fact that the whole house rests on his wife. But she suddenly leaves and leaves the hero alone. How will a rock 'n' roll father cope with the household and raising three daughters?

name: Girl Gun Lady
summary: Koharu is a dull high school girl who is always alone. Her only hobby is making plastic models. One day, Koharu stops by a mysterious antique shop and purchases a plastic model gun and a toy figure named Alice. After spending the entire night assembling the gun, Koharu wakes up and witnesses bullets flying everywhere in school. She then meets Alice who moves like a human and tells her to get ready for a survival battle called "Girl Gun Fight", where she has to attack her schoolmates with a gun.

name: Taffy
summary: A hungry raccoon named Zecki picks up a trick to gain access to Mrs. Münzberg's swanky villa and eat the most delicious delicacies there: he disguises himself as an adorable kitten "Taffy"! But Mrs. Münzberg's beloved dog Bentley is not easily fooled and does everything she can to expose Taffy.

name: Midtown
summary: Two NYPD Cops who never shut up debate mundane topics such as coffee, cologne, and who's got a gluten allergy.

name: The Sons of Sam: A Descent into Darkness
summary: Directed by Joshua Zeman, the series revisits the infamous string of murders that shook New York City in the late Seventies but also explores the argument that David Berkowitz wasn't a lone killer. To that end, the series delves into the work of journalist Maury Terry, who became convinced Berkowitz hadn't acted alone and spent decades trying to prove it.

name: Familiesagaen De syv søstre
summary: The series is about the lives of several different families who are bonded together in different ways in the fictional town Solbekk. The title of the series reflects the name of a club in which most of the women in the series takes part.

name: When Nature Calls with Helen Mirren
summary: When Nature Calls with Helen Mirren is a laugh-out-loud, one-hour unscripted comedy series which looks at the lighter side of the natural world.

name: The Yearbook
summary: Have you still remembered your friends in "The Yearbook"? A series that will bring you back to the early 2000 and the deep connection between Phob and Nut. When the two of them promised to follow their dreams together. Unfortunately, someone didn't keep the promise and that led to disagreement. There was only pain left between them. Finally, they were apart. Four years later, the yearbook brings that one friend comes back again with some truths. At the end, their friendship, intimacy, and dreams will return again or they have to face the the reality and left everything as memories in the Yearbook.

name: Monaco Franze - Der ewige Stenz
summary: The main character, the "Eternal Stenz", is the 50-year-old Munich detective and bon vivant Franz Münchinger. Münchinger, lives happily with his wife Annette von Soettingen in Munich-Schwabing. He loves his city and he loves his wife Annette, whom he affectionately calls "Spatzl". And Annette loves Monaco, even if she comes from much better circles than him. But Monaco also loves adventure. He has a burning interest in the female sex and he also maintains more or less stable relationships with other women, which Annette is well aware of. His best friend Manfred "Manni" Kopfeck, who, like Münchinger, works as a detective commissioner for the Munich police, regularly helps him initiate these affairs and hide them from his wife in an amusing way. Monaco's wife Annette runs an antiques shop and - according to her parentage - is in the so-called better society, with which Monaco can only partially identify. This contrast often leads to humorous situations, for example when Monaco tries to avoid going to the opera.

name: BankGiro Loterij: De gemene deler
summary: Three candidates unknown to each other must make as much money as possible. After a question round the candidates must try divide to the money mutually, but not everyone can get the same amount of money. How long the candidates take agreeing the money split, the less money remains. The candidates must therefore come to a decision who gets what amount. The quiz has multiple choice questions of general knowledge, but also of human nature, conviction strength, calm and speed. Who is a born leader, has the best arguments and keeps his/her cool?

name: Norge i krig - oppdrag Afghanistan
summary: For half a year, journalists from NRK followed the Norwegian soldiers in Afghanistan. We follow the soldiers of the Norwegian camp in Meymaneh in Faryabprovinsen.

name: Glamourjentene
summary: The series depicted the everyday life of Helene Rask and seven glamor models in her agency, Rask Models.

name: Berulfsens Fargerike
summary: In all cultures, colors have been used in a symbolic sense, and have always been attributed certain characteristics. The colors know no bounds, and hide many stories. Torkjell Berulfsen and Rolf Larsen have traveled the world to find these stories. The result is this TV series.

name: Årets Feteste Fyr
summary:
Eight fat guys have gathered for pranks and fun in Gran Canaria to find out which of them will return to the motherland with the title of the fattest guy of the year.

What do you think happens if you take four party-happy guys from the village and four equally party-happy guys from Oslo, and gather them for light-hearted competitions and challenges in the south? Yes, then you will find out who is the fattest guy of the year!

In this web series, you will become better acquainted with an unbridled group of boys on a boy's trip to Gran Canaria. Every day, they will compete in the least intelligent challenges and unscrupulous tasks imaginable, where the winner gets honor and glory, while the losers are punished. It's hard and brutal in true Jackass style, and bruises, vomiting and roars of laughter sit loose. To win the title, they must prove that they are the most playful, street-smart and daring guy on Playa del Ingles. Together they will bring the most shame and some pride in their gender. This is necessary when we on TV3 play nominate the fattest guy of the year!

name: Bygg Og Bedrag
summary: In TV3's new TV series Bygg & Bedrag, people who have fallen victim to rogue tradesmen will be helped to solve their problems. Host Janne Seime Siler has ten years of experience in consumer journalism, and she is not afraid to confront dishonest tradesmen. In addition, TV3's team of experts and partners will ensure that the refurbishment is carried out professionally.

name: Fra sjel til sjel
summary: In her new program, medium Gro-Helen Tørum will travel around to people who carry a strong desire to get in touch with a friend or relative who has passed away. She will act as a link between our world and the other side, so that people can convey what they have in mind or ask questions.

name: Hit og Dit
summary: Hit og dit is a travel program with a clear consumer profile. Each program contains a total of three reports, and the main journey itself is by Kjersti Idem. It means a life in a suitcase in the time ahead. Over the next few months, she will visit Greece, the Maldives, Panama and Japan, among other places. - The show is a consumer-friendly program, with everything from how to prepare before you travel, to skin tips in the sun and other practical things along the way.

name: Bregus
summary:
This 6-part drama series focuses on Ellie's not-as-it-seems perfect life. Ellie seems to have it all – the perfect husband, daughter and close-knit group of friends. The unbreakable gang are all in their mid-thirties. They depend on each other, they're a family.

But what happens when tragedy strikes and unleashes demons in Ellie that threaten the façade of her life and even the core of her sanity.

name: You're My Sky
summary:
Tohn is a first-year college student who loves playing basketball and dreams of becoming a high-level player. Although he is committed to success, he is reunited with Tupfah, an older former basketball player whom he used to know, and who has now put his own sporting ambitions on ice. Tohn feels attracted to Tupfah, but is unsure about whether or not he should tell Tupfah about his feelings or not, worried that doing so might cause problems. But as they spend more time together, a bond of friendship develops as Tohn tries to convince the older student to return to the sport – but could this all end up turning into love?

However, their hearts – and sporting hopes – are not the only ones on the line. Aii is hoping to win a scholarship to study abroad. To do so, he will need to secure high grades at college. But although he does want to gain a place at a Japanese university, his head is turned by a football player with dazzling good looks, threatening to divert his focus away from his school work. Meanwhile, two relay team track runners find themselves attracted to one another – despite the fact that one is dating the other's sister!

name: Kadee Rak Kham Pop
summary: Puncha is an investigator and met Dunchaya who happens to be the suspect in poisoning a victim by being the one who made the food. Because of fear, she ran away and Puncha chased her. They were in a boat and strange things happen leading them to two crossed back to 1913. Puncha had to temporarily stop investigations into the case of Dunchaya, and they were looking for a way back together, but the two were accidentally involved in a murder case. Looking for a way to get back from the present time, the two investigated the case but the matter was not as simple as the leads thought, many killed in a row and they have to find who is doing it.

name: Dong Phaya Yen
summary: Phaya Yen is a mysterious jungle where many bandits assembled. This place has a story: in the deepest parts of the jungle, there's a deserted town where is full of golden treasure hidden named ‘Kwangtaburi'. Up until now, no one steps inside due to fear of mystery, fierce creatures and wicked bandits. And so the adventure story of Petch Phayaprai began. He came here just to seek for his father who got lost in this jungle and never returned. He studied the route to get inside and believed that his father might have gotten lost somewhere in Kwangtaburi. There he met a mysterious lady Sroi and grandmother Thong (who hid the secret that she could turn into a magic tiger), and saved them from their opponents. Petch later took them back to the village, without knowing that they were not just ordinary people. Robbery cases happened day by day in Phaya Yen jungle, making this place very dangerous. Deputy Jerd was assigned to beat all bandits but he got spelled by a creature and disappeared, leading to his arrogant daughter Chan and her fiancé Tadthep came to find him. They asked many guides to lead the way into the jungle but only Petch agreed to do this task, with the goal to find his own father as well. Along the journey, Chan found out that Petch was strong and dependable so she fell for him, and even treated Tadthep poorly. However, Petch loved Sroi whom he did not know was princess Sroisuda-dhevi of Kwangtaburi who escaped from the gangster of Garong. What will Petch decide when he finds out the true identity of Sroi? And will he defeat all the obstacles and save his father?

name: Life Coach
summary: Ailada is a sweet-hardworking woman; who runs an online clothing sales page with her friend Sushi. Ailada lives together with her boyfriend, Fin, A salesman whose parents passed away when he was a child. The couple has financial problems, and Ailada is the sole contributor to paying the rent for the house and the utility bills. One day while working, Fin runs into one of his friends that suggests to him a company that can make him so-called "rich" and makes money easily. Fin tells Alida about the offer but she finds the whole situation sketchy and rejects the proposition. Frustrated by Alida response and his inferiority complex of not being able to provide, Fin gets into an argument with her. While being overwhelmed with stress, Ailada goes to Facebook and comes across Venus; a public figure that can supposedly help people with wealth and happiness, by giving advice to others and holding classes. Ailada then starts to think about the goals she wants to set and reach in the future. The next morning, desperate Ailada goes to meet Venus for help. Will Ailada get the desired advice she's always been wanting to hear? Will Ailada get to finally do the things that make her happy while living a stable life?

name: Wanthong
summary: Wanthong was brought to trial as people condemned her for being in a love triangle and could not choose who to be her husband between "Khun Paen" and "Khun Chang". The king ordered her to choose but she refused to do so, then Wanthong began telling her story to the king. 17 years ago, Wanthong was in love with Khun Paen and they lived together. However, Khun Chang who secretly loved Wanthong tricked her that Khun Paen was killed and made her be his own. When Khun Paen returned victoriously, he found that Wanthong had become Khun Chang's wife and was angry. Meanwhile, Wanthong became heartbroken as Khun Paen brought back another wife. She nonetheless forgave Khun Paen and wanted to be with him again by using Khun Chang as a tool. Khun Chang was mad and confined her in a room. He then planned to get rid of Khun Paen but Khun Paen noticed his evil scheme and therefore traveled to find a magic item to get Wanthong back. Between the man she loved but was not one-girl kind of a guy, and the man who only loved her but treated her like an object…Who would Wanthong choose in the end?

name: The Wonderland of Ten Thousands
summary: The master of Ye Xing Yun will ascend to heaven, leaving behind the great strength of the Tian Yuan Sect, and Ye Xing Yun making the new Sovereign of the Tian Yuan Sect, and at the request of his master, seek revenge by entering into a small family while waiting to perform revenge. Ye Xing Yun embarks on an extremely dangerous road, but with his strategy, and with the help of the masters of the Tian Yuan Sect, his long-term strategy of confrontation with the huge Zhou dynasty.

name: The Food That Built America: Snack Sized
summary: You may think you know all there is to know about the Food That Built America, but there's more to the story. In this new series, The History Channel delves even deeper into the stories behind the ruthless innovators and entrepreneurs featured in the Food That Built America. Spotlighting the rest of the story you didn't know, the series tells the super-charged, bite-sized history of all of the foods you love in 30 minutes or less.

name: Love Scenery
summary:
Adapted from the novel "Ming Qiang Yi Duo, An Jian Nan Fang" (明枪易躲, 暗恋难防) by Qiao Yao (翘摇).
An idol singer who shines brightly on the stage turns out to have the gaming skills of an elementary school student. Meanwhile, a smart and handsome university student immerses in the game, not knowing that his beloved idol is on the other side of the screen. Through interlaced time and space, an online crush turns into a budding love. What will happen between the talented female singer and the top male student?

name: Parot
summary: A police inspector tries to find out who has murdered numerous inmates who could have been released from prison thanks to the cancellation of the controversial Parot doctrine.

name: High Flyers
summary: High Flyers traces the lives of a group of ordinary kids, sharing their disappointments and triumphs as they discover their collective talents in an extraordinary children's circus. When Luke and Phoebe move to the country, first impressions of their new home aren't encouraging. New school, no friends, in the middle of nowhere — who needs it? But when they discover it has its own circus for kids, the dramas, adventures, relationships and backflips unfold.

name: Food Avengers
summary: The new program aims to combine eco-friendly cooking with fun cooking broadcasts. Through Food-vengers, top chefs and cast members will create and present new menus using leftover ingredients to promote zero-waste cooking.

name: Norges Grillmester
summary: Norwegian barbecue enthusiasts gather at the idyllic Villa Malla in Hurum to compete to become Norway's Grill Champion. Two barbecue tasks are on the menu each episode and two judges judge which couple is allowed to stay and who has to go home.

name: Top Model Norge
summary: 15 participants start with long legs, pointed elbows and high ambitions. The girls must cope with both difficult challenges and each other, and at the same time be prepared to pack their bags and travel to unknown places at short notice. The winner of Top Model gets the chance to enter a world full of fashion, a lot of work and great experiences.

name: Leo tar valget
summary: Leo is a first-time voter and has learned through eight episodes that everything is politics. Now he will teach you the same thing.

name: Og nå: Reklame!
summary: Og nå: Reklame! is a series that documented advertising; showing how deceptive the advertisement industry can be.

name: Olsenbanden jr. første kupp
summary: Olsenbanden jr. første kupp is about Olsenbanden's first coup. The story takes place in the 1950s and the gang members are only 12-13 years old. Egon Olsen meets Benny Fransen and Kjell Jensen when he, as a new student at the school, makes his first friends. And it does not take long before they end up in trouble. Egon lives in an orphanage, and each year the orphanage is awarded a large sum of money to celebrate Christmas for. This year, however, the Christmas fund is empty, and Egon suspects that the law firm that looks after the fund has emptied it of money. The Olsen band, led by Egon, starts the hunt for the Christmas fund, and the gang gets into many exciting and fun situations - as the Olsen band is also known for.

name: Sigrid søker selskap
summary: In this series, Sigrid Bonde Tusvik will help three single Eastfolders to find a new boyfriend. This is a crazy dating carousel over eight weeks with laughter, tears, banter and romances.

name: Soria Moria
summary: The action takes place in Crow Castle Soria Moria, a forest village. Soria Moria is a guest house, and has been the village's main hall for all these years. During the war, the owner, called "Great Erling", was shot by the Germans here, and his ghost is repeated on Soria Moria. At the beginning of the series, it is his granddaughter Ragnhild who runs the boarding house together with her husband Håvard. But then a German company buys the crow castle, and an ex-policeman Magnus is hired as manager. He has to deal with new and old residents, and all their problems.

name: Club Friday The Series 12: Ruk Tong Yaeng
Sai Lub Jub Abb‬
summary: Do you ever wonder if your lover, son, nephew or competitor is gay? Wonder no more, because with the right amount of money, you can hire a team of spies who will find the proof for you and avoid any confrontation. Nangfah knows all too well what it's like to date a gay man, after all, she has dated them since grade school and was fooled in every relationship. The last one was the straw that broke the camel's back; she discovered that her then boyfriend was having an affair with her male boss at a gay bar. After the altercation at the gay bar, Nangfah gets fired and blacklisted at all advertising agencies in the city. Desperate for work, she decides to call on an advertisement on Pantip seeking a spy to investigate the sexual orientation of other people.

name: The Biggest Loser Norge
summary: 12 overweight Norwegians start the biggest challenge in their lives: to get rid of their excess life threathening kilograms and change their unhealthy lifestyles.

name: Thune
summary: We follow private detective Ole Thune and his team of detectives investigating cases where the police's original investigation has not been sufficient in solving the case.

name: Anna
summary: A world destroyed and returned to nature by a pandemic that affects only adults, a tenacious and courageous girl in search of her little brother, a story of hope and survival.

previousepisode.name: Cose da fare quando la mamma muore

name: The Crowded Room
summary: The Crowded Room follows Danny Sullivan, a man who is arrested following his involvement in a shooting in New York City in 1979. A captivating thriller told through a series of interviews with curious interrogator Rya Goodwin, Danny's life story unfolds, revealing elements of the mysterious past that shaped him, and the twists and turns that will lead him to a life-altering revelation.

name: The Line
summary: Accompanied by a six-part narrative non-fiction audio series, The Line offers a unique perspective on previously untold aspects of the story of US Navy SEAL Eddie Gallagher, who was charged with committing war crimes before ultimately being acquitted on all but one count: for posing in a photo with a corpse. Both series will examine the complicated realities involved with fighting a decades-long war, stripping back the layers surrounding Gallagher's alleged crimes.

name: Crime Scene Kitchen
summary: Crime Scene Kitchen, an all-new baking competition series is a culinary guessing game in which bakers are tasked with decoding what type of dessert was made, when all that's left are the crumbs, flour trails and a few elusive clues. They must then recreate the recipe for celebrity judges, chef Curtis Stone and cake artist Yolanda Gampp, who will determine how closely their sweet treat matches the missing dessert – and how good it tastes!

name: Ek Hazaaron Mein Meri Behna Hai
summary: Two sisters who love each other enough to share their life and breath with each other.

name: Chu Feng: Yi Dian Shizi
summary:
Ordinary high school student Haoxuan Sun was taken hostage in a seemingly robbery and rescued by a girl wearing winged battledress with bee bionics designs. Haoxuan Sun's peaceful life was stirred by the girl – human bioengineering weapon Vanguard Liuli. Discovered that he is the "Son of Eden" wanted by all the great powers, Haoxuan Sun and Liuli have been searching for the truth and fight against the so-called destiny. At the same time, people around Haoxuan Sun, senpai Ye Bai who he has a crash on, his best friend, and many others, were discovered to have a second identities.

The new BEE anime is based on the original manga plot. In addition, BEE manga's author Baimao personally joined the production team. The new BEE will also include two subplots entirely new to the viewers.

name: Algeria: Test of Power
summary: The story of Algeria's past, present and future - from independence to the Arab Spring and beyond. Algeria was under French colonial rule for 132 years. From tears of joy at independence in 1962 to the tragic civil war of the 1990s and the anger that culminated in the Arab Spring, this series provides a unique insight into a country notoriously inaccessible to both journalists and filmmakers. Interviews with key players like Ben Bella, Ait Ahmed and President Abdelaziz Bouteflika, cover 50 years of tragic and powerful history from the Evian Accords of 1962 to the Arab Spring of 2011. This is the story of Algeria's past, present and future. Produced by Flach Film.

name: Love Area
summary: Valen, a young man born on Valentine's Day but has never known love - not even the love of his parents. He meets someone who shows him compassion and tenderness.

name: PaLoMa
summary: This is the story of three LGBT characters.

name: Deadhouse Dark
summary: Inspired by recent social, cultural and online phenomena, Deadhouse Dark is a boxful of six stories that all take place within the same world – a modern world driven by online connections, constant surveillance, insta-celebrity and an ability to instantly gratify just about any need or desire, no matter how fleeting or dark.

name: Queer As Folk
summary: Queer as Folk is a vibrant reimagining of the groundbreaking British series created by Russell T. Davies, exploring a diverse group of friends in New Orleans whose lives are transformed in the aftermath of a tragedy.

name: Sugar
summary: Sugar follows a young woman in New York who balances her neurotic Jewish family with her life as a college sugar baby.

name: Double Fine Adventure!
summary:
In March 2012, video game legend Tim Schafer made history with the Double Fine Adventure Kickstarter, a crowdfunding campaign that changed the way games are created and funded forever.

For three years, a documentary crew captured the once-secretive process of video game development, chronicling the creation of "Broken Age" from a Kickstarter pitch to a finished game and beyond. Along the way, Schafer and his team at Double Fine persevered through production delays, internal strife, financial crises, looming deadlines, sickness, layoffs, and the weighty expectations of a critical public.

name: Løvebakken
summary: Løvebakken is a Norwegian comedy program. The program was set up as a political party game with elements of theater sports where it was harassed with current political topics and Norwegian politics in general. There were four panelists divided into two teams. One team was to represent the blue party while the others were to represent the red party, after which they were to present arguments for their views. The main element of the program was the nimble minds of the participants and their desperate attempts to solve tasks they were not prepared for. The program was based on the British program If I Ruled the World

name: Unge mødre
summary: In this documentary series we meet many different girls who had children at a young age. We follow their everyday lives and gain insight into the joys and sorrows they experience throughout their lives as a young mother in Norway.

name: Celebrities: What's Happened to Your Face?
summary: Series taking a look at famous names who may have had cosmetic surgery.

name: Britain's Favourite Comedy
summary: Jo Brand presents a celebration of great sketches of the 1970s, 80s and 90s, with each show featuring archive material and contributions from the writers and performers themselves.

name: Blue Reflection Ray
summary: A clear summer sky spreads over the Hoshinomiya Girls' High School. This story begins with the belated start of school life for Hinako Shirai, who has just recovered from a leg injury due to a tragic accident. The magical sisters Yuzu and Lime bestowed her with a special power to become a "Reflector." Hinako transforms into the magical Reflector form and protects the world from devastating forces for the sake of the world, and her own dream that she thought she had to give up on.

name: The 39 Steps
summary: A contemporary take on John Buchan's novel, The 39 Steps centers on Richard Hannay, an ordinary man who became an unwitting pawn in a vast, global conspiracy to reset the world order: 39 Steps that will change the world as we know it, with only Hannay standing in the way.

name: Makeup: A Glamorous History
summary:
In this series, professional makeup artist Lisa Eldridge takes a fascinating journey through the history of hair and makeup.

Taking three iconic eras in British history - The Georgians, the Victorians and the 1920s - Lisa explores what the beauty look tells us about the world it grew out of. From the high hair and heavily painted faces of the aristocratic Georgians, to the demure ‘natural' faces of the middle-class Victorian lady, to the red lipped bobbed hair flapper, the series explores key moments in Britain's past.

name: Death Walker with Nick Groff
summary: Nick Groff theorises and investigates the origin of some of the most notorious hauntings in America, redefining our understanding of the paranormal. Death Walker: a person that walks among the dead.

previousepisode.name: Ghosts in the Herschell Carrousel Museum

name: Die Frauen Der Wikinger
summary: German documentary series about viking women

previousepisode.name: Jovas Erbe und der Untergang Haithabus

name: A League of Their Own Road Trip: Loch Ness to London
summary: The boys are back, hitting the road again for another special edition of A League of Their Own. This time they can't travel abroad so they're going on a staycation. Yes, the road trip is coming home! Once again they'll be joined by familiar faces as they take on a series of challenges across Great Britain.

name: Joe Show
summary: Joe Show is an Arabic talk show and political satire television program hosted by Egyptian comedian Youssef Hussein and it airs each Thursday. The show deals mainly the events in the Arab world in a comic and cynical manner. The 53-minute television program exploits the media lapses, media biases, and striking paradoxes in the rhetoric of political and conflicting positions; It is reintroduced comically. The show consists of 4 segments; the first three cover current events in Egypt, the fourth looks at the rest of the Arab world.

name: Welcome to My Strange City
summary: Follow journalist Alexandra Alevêque and meet people living in the coldest, warmest, highest, most humid, and most densely populated cities in the world. Alexandra will experience life in these extreme cities and live in each one long enough to learn about the locals' way of life and gain insight into humankind's incredible capacity to adapt and find solutions to survive.

name: Movie Stars
summary: The life of a Hollywood couple raising their family in Malibu

name: 100% Era
summary: 100% Era imagines the post-corona future. How the lives of kids born during the pandemic will look like? What will humanity and teens look like in 2044? Our teenagers living in a more competitive world, where the world no longer needs human hands. For humans, the competition to rise to the top is intensifying. How to secretly love children in the era when schools disappeared and contactless. Hee Jae and Shi Dae attend the same top rank education academy. It focuses on training kids to score 100% on tests, while kids who score below 90% get expelled. In such an environment, Shi Dae and Hee Jae spend their teenage years and grow together.

name: The Voice Nigeria
summary: A reality talent show, showcasing Nigeria's strongest undiscovered vocalists as they compete for an ultimate prize with the help of some established superstar coaches.

name: The Mopes
summary: The singer-songwriter Mat is facing a mental crash. Actually he is sufficiently successful, has a steady relationship, is not unhappy with his life. There he meets Monika: She is "efficient, organized" and in the process of earning a promotion - Monika is a "moderate depression", namely Mats. Her current assignment to make life difficult for Mat becomes unusual when he begins to see his depression: That has never happened to Monika and that is not intended! That's supposed to happen to schizophrenia, but not to depression like you. Can it cost her promotion? For his part, Mat does what one should do when seeing non-existent people: he tries to get rid of these hallucinations as quickly as possible.

name: Rauzán
summary: Set in Villa Rauzán, the telenovela centers onSebastián de Mendoza, a mysterious man known for seducing women and then leaving them. He's also suffering from catalepsy, a disease that he has inherited from his father. He meets Soledad de Santiño, a young woman belonging to a prestigious family, and falls in love with her. But one day before his wedding with Soledad, he suffers a cataleptic attack and is buried alive.

name: Underholdningsavdelingen
summary: Norwegian humor series with sketches, parodies, musical performances and madness from top shelf. Robert Stoltenberg, Herborg Kråkevik, Bjarte Tjøstheim, Live Nelvik, Steinjo, Vidar Magnussen and Kristin Grue entertains on Saturday evenings.

name: 9 av 10 Nordmenn
summary: A game show where each week two new people come to the show. They then have to guess on different statistics about the Norwegian people.

previousepisode.name: Per Sundnes, Åsleik Engmark, Triana Iglesias og Yngve Hågensen

name: The Amazing Race Norge
summary: The Amazing Race Norge is modeled after the US Series, with a group of people traveling all over the world in teams of two, aiming to win a cash price at the end.

name: Hvaler
summary: Hvaler is the story of 29-year-old Maria Blix, a young and newly trained psychologist full of ambition. She is in the midst of fierce career challenges when she is told that her father is dead. The message does not seem to affect her much, and she hesitantly travels back to the kingdom of her childhood on Hvaler to go to the funeral and meet the family she has hardly seen in the last ten years.

name: Patriot Brains
summary: Bill Bailey hosts the fast-paced quiz show that pits two teams of comedians against each other, to find out once and for all who's best - Kiwis or Aussies.

name: Fairy Ranmaru: Anata no Kokoro Otasuke Shimasu
summary: Set in a world of cruelty and heartbreak, Fairy Ranmaru: Anata no Kokoro Otasuke Shimasu follows five young men who work at the mysterious "Bar F" and who offer to heal the hearts of their clients, wiping away their tears and causing smiles to bloom like flowers. They take no payment... aside from stealing their clients' hearts.

name: Russia from Above
summary: Natural history series focusing on the spectacular scenery and indigenous wildlife of Russia. The team undertakes a nine month venture to capture the length and breadth of the largest country on Earth from a birds eye view with the best aerial cameras in the world including locations granted film permits for the very first time in cinematic history.

name: Den unge Fleksnes
summary: Den unge Fleksnes is an Advent calendar for TV, which will be broadcast on TVNorge Christmas 2010. The series is about the character Marve Fleksnes, known from the Norwegian comedy series Fleksnes fatalities, as a 13-year-old.

name: Popstokk
summary: Popstokk is synonymous with Friday night, good music, nice guests, laughter and great atmosphere! Host Erik Solbakken kicks off the weekend with a music competition where the whole family can participate.

previousepisode.name: Jon Rørmark, Åsleik Engmark, Jan Martin Johnsen og Yngvild Grotmol

name: Wipeout
summary: Wipeout is an American TV concept, and this Norwegian version is a co-production with Sweden and Denmark. Norwegians, Swedes and Danes compete for the prize of NOK 50,000. The host of the Norwegian broadcast is Synnøve Skarbø, with the two comedians Anders Hoff and Øyvind Rafto from Raske Menn as commentators.

name: Landeplage
summary: Landeplage is a documentary series with Ivar "Ravi" Johansen. The program deals with well-known Norwegian pop and rock songs that had maintained their popularity for many years. Among other things, the program tried to investigate why this particular one became such a big hit.

name: Lyngbø og Hærlands Big Bang
summary: A popular science entertainment program with a permanent panel of experts. The comedy duo Dagfinn Lyngbø and Anne-Kat. Hærland asks the questions they have always wanted answered. These are the small questions about the big topics.

name: Den siste viking
summary: Den siste viking is a magnificent and highly expensive reality series where 18 Norwegians are sent a thousand years back in time to measure knowledge and strength. The one with the highest Viking percentage in the blood remains the winner. Host Trond Espen Seim leads the reality game in character, as a good - the one who speaks for the Gods. The participants do not know what they are going for, but quickly realize that this will be much tougher than expected.

name: The People V. The Klan
summary: A four-part docuseries that tells the little-known true story of Beulah Mae Donald, a Black mother in Alabama, who took down the Ku Klux Klan after the brutal murder and lynching of her son, Michael Donald. He was just nineteen years old when he was found dead, hanging from a tree in Mobile, on March 21, 1981. The local Black community immediately suspected it was a Klan lynching, but local law enforcement was slow to acknowledge that the murder was racially motivated. Beulah Mae and local Black leaders refused to back down until Michael's killers and the hateful organization they belonged to were brought to justice.

name: Grottenveien 1
summary: Four couples move into identical and dilapidated apartments in a four-person home in Oslo. Love is put to the test when they renovate the apartment room by room, and make gold out of gray stone. The couples get 350,000 kroner and ten weeks at their disposal on the way to the big goal: to sell the apartment at an auction.

name: Hellstrøms Mesterkokk
summary: In Hellstrøms Mesterkokk, 14 men and women who already work in restaurant kitchens will meet in a tough competition. Chefs in the Norwegian elite, chefs with experience from the world's best restaurants and young, brilliant culinary talents are given tasks in food and cooking, and they must perform their very best to advance in the competition. The competitors travel to Western Norway and Northern Norway to work with the best raw materials. Master chef Eyvind Hellstrøm will in each program select one who must leave the competition, and in the end he chooses "his" new chef. The winner of Hellstrøm's master chef receives NOK 250,000, as well as a paid study stay at two of New York's foremost restaurants, "Daniel" and "Per Se". Both restaurants have three stars in the Michelin guide.

name: Radioresepsjonen på TV
summary: Tore Sagen, Bjarte Tjøstheim and Steinar Sagen's light-hearted entertainment program with sketches, discussion, debate and the occasional guest. Why should you watch the Radio Reception on TV, you ask. Well, why do you actually watch TV? To make time go by.

name: Bartenderskolen
summary:
18 young girls and boys will compete for the opportunity to realize their bartender dream. On the Greek island of Kos is the European Bartender School, where hungry and ambitious young people can get help on the way to the goal of making a good living from the bartending profession.

Through four weeks of intense training, teaching and practice, the participants will fight to become the litter's best bartender. At the Bartender School, the students live close to each other for a longer period, and in the series we also follow the participants after the school day is over. With it, the viewers also get an insight into an extravagant culture, where fleeting connections and strong bonds of friendship come and go among young people who want to take in all that life has to offer. However, the competitive element in the series gets the final word, and tough challenges behind the bar give participants the opportunity to show that they have a bartender star in them. Anyone who does not keep the required level falls through, and the strict judges put the list high.

name: Roast fra Chat Noir
summary: Based on the American version, Roast fra Chat Noir will see celebrities roast each other.

name: Amerika utenfor allfarveg
summary: Series about the United States.

name: Nummer 1
summary: 11 boys and girls aged 15-17 arrive at Helgelandsmoen where they will live and compete in the coming weeks. They will fight to be named Norway's greatest goalkeeper talent. The winner gets a stay at Liverpool FC. Frode Grodås and Stig Inge Bjørnebye are coaches and put the young people to hard tests.

name: Robinsonekspedisjonen vinter
summary: Winter is something most Norwegians are familiar with, but does the average Norwegian manage to survive outside in the winter? . In Robinsonekspedisjonen vinter, we have sent a group of Norwegians to to a deserted Pacific island to see how they cope with the freezing cold.

name: Siffer
summary: Jo Røislien sees reality in a special way. He is, basically, a mathematician who sees everything around him by mathematicians glasses. Mathematics can make the world easier to understand. How can this be possible? Can figures have such significance for humans?

name: Amigo
summary: Amigo, a game show for you who want something more! With tough participants, even tougher challenges and great prizes.

name: Amigo Grande
summary: Game show for the whole family. Three generations. Two families. One southern trip.

name: Anno
summary: 14 participants travel back in time to experience different eras in Norwegian history. They will work their way up from poverty and toil to wealth and honor. But only one can run away with the victory and the citizens' letter.

name: Diktaturet
summary: The series is a social experiment whose purpose is to get Norwegian youth to appreciate their voting rights, and use it in this year's municipal elections. We meet eight people with completely different backgrounds. Isolated in an unfamiliar place, they must live in a dictatorship with strict rations and curfews, without access to natural light, and with unpredictable orders from an invisible regime. During the coming days, participants get really feel on your body what it is like to be deprived of rights and benefits which they might otherwise take for granted.

name: Hvem kan slå Ylvis?
summary: Ordinary Norwegians can challenge the Ylvis brothers in a number of varied and challenging competitions. The prize is up to one million kroner.

name: Kvelden er din
summary: Two presenters help fulfill the dreams of people they thought deserved it. Before that happened, the candidates were tricked with a hidden camera. Friends or family members signed up for those who wanted their dream to come true.

name: Ante
summary: A series for children about the Sami boy Ante.

name: Luftens Helter
summary: Cuts at SAS mean that Captain Odd Grenland and 2nd pilot Birger Wom are fired because they are too old. Grenland buys a used aircraft with his own money, and together they start the company Senior-Air, which will compete with SAS on the Oslo-Bergen route. With them they get the mechanical genius Joar "Jojo" Johansen, Jasmin Rosenrot, former cabin manager in Spantax and the number genius Karl Åge Tørkle.

name: Nordkalotten 365
summary: For 365 days, experienced hiker Lars Monsen travels alone through the Cap of the North, the wilderness of Northern Scandinavia. We follow the daily events of Monsen's adventure, his interaction with the local people and wildlife, and the changing of the seasons.

name: Antikviteter og snurrepiperier
summary: Program about collectibles, antiques, old dishes and displays from bygone times.

name: Tonight med Timothy Dahle
summary: Timothy Dahle, best known as the manager of Boyzvoice, and former participant of Nissene På Låven, has had his own talk show on TV.

name: Truls - Oppdrag Hurtigruten
summary: Thomas Numme, Harald Rønneberg and two other friends send Truls Svendsen on a number of fun assignments along the Norwegian coast in Truls - Oppdrag Hurtigruten. Before Truls can board the Hurtigruten in Bergen, he must go through a hefty safety course which, among other things, involves a drop of thirty meters with a lifeboat. The trip later goes to Florø where he learns beer brewing at Kinn Brewery and to Stadt where surfing puts Truls' physics to the test. On Måløy there will be spectacular nature experiences, and on Herøy Truls will be commissioned to play the main role in a historical game.

name: Akvariet
summary: For half a year, TV 2's team has followed everyday life at the Aquarium in Bergen, and the result has been a documentary series in six parts packed with drama, cute penguins, dangerous reptiles, fish, harnesses and enthusiastic animal keepers.

name: Årsrevyen med Harald Eia
summary: Bård Tufte Johansen and Harald Eia sum up the past year, and with them they have an elite team of Norwegian comedians. Harald Eia is the host and a rolling panel will every week try to remember what was important news in 2014.

previousepisode.name: Mikkel Niva, Erik Solbakken, Pernille Sørensen, Tore Sagen

name: Jul med Hellstrøm
summary: Eyvind Hellstrøm takes the dog and good friends to Gol to enjoy the pre-Christmas period. Viewers are also invited to see how the master chef celebrates the holiday, and not least how he prepares Christmas food. There are still one or two restaurant managers in this country who hardly dream of celebrating Christmas with the Bagatelle manager. After a hectic and hectic clean-up tour all over the country, we have become better acquainted with the adult perfectionist Hellstrøm. But at the cabin among friends, he shows other sides of himself. Eyvind Hellstrøm counts down the days until Christmas Eve.

previousepisode.name: Anne-Kat Hærland og Ingrid Espelid Hovig

name: Schmokk
summary: Janne breaks up with her boyfriend Pontus, because living with him isn't the romantic fairytale she expected from a relationship. But life without him might not be exactly perfect either.

name: Toget - På sporet av en morder
summary: One of NSB's passenger trains is on the way from Oslo to Bergen. Aboard the train are two investigators on the way home and on vacation. Suddenly the train is buried by an avalanche in Finse, and when the power comes back, they discover that two passengers have been murdered.

name: Jakten på Norge 1814-2014
summary: Factual series on Norwegian history for the Constitution Anniversary. What is Norwegian and what makes us Norwegians? And where did the original constitution from Eidsvoll go? Haddy N'jie and Swede Per Sinding-Larsen are hunting for the Norwegian and his constitution.

name: Torsdagsklubben
summary: Torsdagsklubben is a satirical comedy program. The program is led by Silje Stang, with Otto Jespersen and Thomas Giertsen as regular panelists. In addition, two guests appear in each show.

name: F2: Forensic Factor
summary: Forensic Factor presents the world's best CSI's armed with the latest investigative tools in the hunt to catch elusive criminals. Each episode explores one baffling case, revealing the amazing science being used by North America's top crime fighters.

name: Der Elefant: Mord verjährt nie
summary:
Some crimes go unnoticed. Some criminals go free. These cops go after them. 

Chief inspector Matthias Steiner has been heading the Department of Unsolved Crimes for three years now. Thanks to his dogged persistence and to the tireless fieldwork of his loyal teammate Julia, he's put more than one perpetrator of the "perfect crime" behind bars.
To celebrate their success, Steiner's boss rewards them with a new teammate, the eager, go-get-'em rookie Andreas. Their first case together arrives in the form of a little girl whom the police have found wandering alone in the city. Steiner is intrigued when she says that her name is Britta Leschkov, since he remembers that a child of the same name died of poisoning six years ago.
He personally returns the child to her parents, who react so strangely that he and his colleagues reopen the investigation into the death of the first "Britta." What they uncover is a sordid tale of hatred, abuse, dependency and murderous revenge.

name: Eden
summary: Eden follows the disappearance of a young woman which triggers a devastating chain of events which lays bare the dark, hidden heart of paradise. Long buried secrets are dragged into the open as lives and deeds of local residents intersect over one fractured summer and its aftermath.

name: Chacha Vidhayak Hain Humare
summary: Ronny's whole life is based on a lie. To the world he is the nephew of the MLA and a wanna be youth leader who solves people's problems. But in reality, Ronny is a jobless 26 year old with no relation to the MLA who shares his surname. The show explores Ronny's adventures as he gets stuck in multiple situations because of this lie.

name: Popeye and Son
summary: Popeye and Olive are now married, and they have a son, Popeye Jr. Bluto is also married- to a woman named Lizzie- and he also has a son, Tank. The kids are just like their father... except Popeye Jr. hates spinach. Wimpy has a nephew, Francis.

name: Why Didn't They Ask Evans?
summary: When Bobby Jones and Lady Frances "Frankie" Derwent play a round of golf, Bobby slices his ball over the edge of a cliff. His ball is lost, but on the rocks below he finds the crumpled body of a dying man. With his final breath the man opens his eyes and gasps, ‘Why didn't they ask Evans?'  Armed only with the image of a beautiful young woman found in the dead man's pocket, the amateur sleuths must solve the case.

name: FROM
summary: FROM unravels the mystery of a nightmarish town that traps all those who enter. As the unwilling residents fight to keep a sense of normalcy and search for a way out, they must also survive the threats of the surrounding forest – including the terrifying creatures that come out when the sun goes down. In season two, hidden truths about the nature and terrifying origins of the town begin to emerge, even as life for its residents is plunged into chaos by the arrival of mysterious newcomers.

previousepisode.name: If a Tree Falls in the Forest...

name: Cinema Toast
summary: Cinema Toast is a post-modernist reinvention of older movies that turns pre-existing imagery from the public domain on its head to tell brand new unique stories.

name: Back in the Soviet Bloc
summary: Upon discovering her Soviet background, Julia Nalivaiko's friends often ask, "What's it like over there?". To answer, she traveled to Russia and Ukraine with Australian filmmaker Stuart McBratney, in an attempt to better understand the country she left as a child.

name: Popstars
summary: The original talent reality show is back - bigger, better and re-imagined for 2021!  Gifted hopefuls perform for a panel led by international superstar, Kimbra, for a shot at $100,000. Popstars is a New Zealand reality documentary television show. The first series aired on TVNZ in 1999 and showed the establishment of a five-piece girl group, TrueBliss. The series was the origin of the Popstars reality TV series format, which went on to be sold to over 50 countries.

name: Capital One College Bowl
summary: Capital One College Bowl challenges college students out of the classroom and puts their knowledge to the test as they compete for academic scholarships. In each episode, teams of three representing some of the nation's top schools will battle it out in a bracketed tournament over four rounds. Teams must work together to answer questions on a wide variety of subjects. The top two schools advance to the final where they compete head-to-head for the Capital One College Bowl trophy and a scholarship to put toward their education.

name: Droners
summary:
Race to save the planet!

Welcome to TERRAQUA, a world 95% covered by water! Team Tikis — Corto, Arthus, Enki and Mouse — strive to win the Whale Cup, the most extreme drone race of all time.

They will test their mettle and compete against the fiercest opponents from all parts of the world. They'll need to pull off the craziest tricks, tap into the need-for-speed, and navigate the most incredible drone circuits ever imagined.

Failure isn't an option: the fate of the Tikis' archipelago relies on their victory!
